question: Which harvest festival in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana is celebrated for four days with the Bhogi bonfire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sankranti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sankranti**, also known as **Makara Sankranti**, is a major **harvest festival celebrated in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana**. It marks the transition of the Sun into the zodiac sign Capricorn (**Makara**) on its celestial path.
 
• It is celebrated for **four days**, each with specific rituals and customs: Bhogi, Makara Sankranti, Kanuma, and Mukkanuma.
 
• The first day, **Bhogi**, involves lighting a bonfire with agricultural waste and wood. People discard old items and celebrate new beginnings. **Hence, the Bhogi bonfire is an integral part of the festival.**
 
• The festival signifies **gratitude to nature** for a good harvest and is marked by family gatherings, traditional foods, and cultural activities.</li&g
